name: QTT Plan
description: A sellable plan, always for exactly one product. plan_code is unique per (product, plan_code) — NOT globally, so 'Professional' can exist once for QMP_LMS and once for QTT_HRMS without collision. See the QTT SaaS Platform architecture document, section 10.

fields.label: Plan Code
fields.description: Unique within its product, e.g. 'starter', 'professional', 'enterprise' — not globally unique. See patches/v0_3 for the DB-level (product, plan_code) constraint.

fields.label: Is Public
fields.description: Unpublished plans (0) can still be assigned to a tenant manually but won't appear in a self-service plan picker.

fields.label: Razorpay Plan ID
fields.description: Set once, reused for every subscription on this plan — never re-created per signup (SaaS lifecycle Phase C). Populated by qtt_platform.billing.service.ensure_razorpay_plan() the first time it's needed; blank until then. System-Manager-visible only, same trust boundary as the rest of this doctype.
